question: If a face-down Hooded Hydra is turned face up in some way other than paying its morph cost, does it still get its five +1/+1 counters?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the last ability still applies, however the Hydra is turned face up.
expected.answer: If Hooded Hydra is face down and it's turned face up some other way than by having its morph cost paid, the last ability will still apply.

whyHard: Players tie the counters to paying the morph cost instead of to the moment the card is turned face up.
